offers.name: ASUS ROG Strix SCAR 18" WQXGA 240Hz HDR Mini-LED Gaming Laptop - Intel Core i9-14900HX - 32GB DDR5 - 1TB SSD - RTX 4080 - Windows 11 Home - Off Black

reviews.quote: Average 85.67% across 37 aggregated scores for the G834 series: desktop-crushing RTX 4080/4090 performance and a superb 240Hz mini-LED panel, at a premium price.

praises: Outstanding prev-gen value: RTX 4080 12GB + 18" 240Hz Mini-LED HDR for under $2,800 — cheaper than most new mid-range 5060/5070 laptops with worse screens (BBY 4.5/5, n=505)
18" Mini-LED panel still looks superb — high contrast HDR, 240Hz, praised consistently across the 500+ review pool
i9-14900HX is still a top-20 mobile CPU for gaming and multitasking; 32GB RAM and 1TB hit the sweet spot
User-serviceable: 2x SODIMM + 2x M.2 — cheap RAM/SSD upgrades instead of paying ASUS markup
Mature platform — early G834 firmware/thermal issues long since patched; drivers stable
complaints: RTX 4080 12GB VRAM is the aging point: DLSS3 without DLSS4 multi-frame-gen, and 12GB constrains newest AAA ultra textures at 2.5K
Older chassis: no Wi-Fi 7, weaker webcam (720p), and bulkier design than the 2025 G835 refresh
Battery ~4h light use — same desktop-replacement story
Fan noise under load; turbo mode loud, and 14900HX runs hot (Raptor Lake HX known for high clocks/heat)
Clearance-stock risk: sale pricing fluctuates and remaining units are late-of-life for warranty runway

design_philosophy: The 2023/24 G834 SCAR 18 defined the current formula — max-TGP GPU, 18" Mini-LED Nebula HDR, serviceable internals — and now survives at clearance pricing as the line's value door. At $2,800 this i9/RTX 4080 tier offers last-gen flagship gaming (4080 ≈ current 5070-Ti class raster) with the same big-screen Mini-LED experience, for buyers who can accept 12GB VRAM and DLSS3-era upscaling.
